description: This file implements a file-backed credentials management service for device registration, allowing credentials to be loaded from and saved to a file. It provides methods for retrieving, setting, and deleting device credentials, handling resource versioning, validation, and persistence configuration.

classes.name: FileBasedCredentialsService
classes.description: A file-backed in-memory credentials management service implementing credentials load/save, retrieval, and modification with support for resource versioning and validation.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the service, optionally loading credentials from a file and starting periodic persistence.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down the service and saves credentials to file if configured.

methods.name: loadCredentials
methods.description: Loads credentials from the configured file during startup.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Adds multiple credentials from a JSON array read from the file.

methods.name: addCredentialsForTenant
methods.description: Adds or updates credentials for a specific tenant from JSON object data.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves credentials for a tenant, authId, and type, including support for client context and span for tracing.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets or updates credentials for a device, with resource versioning and validation.

methods.name: checkCredential
methods.description: Validates credentials, especially password secrets, including hash verification.

methods.name: verifyBcryptPasswordHash
methods.description: Verifies that a bcrypt hash is valid and within the allowed number of iterations.

methods.name: removeAllForDevice
methods.description: Removes all credentials associated with a specific device within a tenant.

methods.name: getOrCreateResourceVersion
methods.description: Generates or retrieves the current resource version for a device.

methods.name: setResourceVersion
methods.description: Updates the resource version for a device.

methods.name: getSingleCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves the first matching credential of a specified type for a tenant and authId, considering client context.

methods.name: createOrGetCredentialsForTenant
methods.description: Ensures a credentials map exists for a tenant.

methods.name: createOrGetAuthIdCredentials
methods.description: Creates or retrieves credentials array for a given authId within a tenant.
